create_prepare_rollout: prepare rollout session data on a batch before the denoising loop
run_flow_sde_sampling: run flow-matching SDE, CPS, or ODE sampling with log-prob computation per denoising step
collect_rollout_log_probs: collect accumulated rollout log-prob sums averaged over denoising steps for a batch
create_rollout_variance_noise: generate sharded variance noise for rollout using per-item generators
release_rollout_resources: release rollout session data and buffers from a batch after denoising ends
